entities.summary: Gawriil Ioakimowitsch Lomakin (b. 1812-04-06, Borisovka, Borisovsky District, Belgorod Oblast) was a monarch or head of state of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Borisovka, Borisovsky District, Belgorod Oblast. Known in the fields of educators & academics.
